canon.silhouette: a T - a wide horizontal ribbed bar of fire riding across the shoulders over a narrow waist and narrow legs
canon.reads_as: a narrow figure under a wide iron crossbar of fire - top-heavy, the light riding on the shoulders

prompt.description: A narrow figure under a wide flat-brimmed iron hat, carrying a broad iron brazier basket mounted on a back frame so that it rides across the shoulders and sticks out well past them on both sides. The basket is a long horizontal cage of thick vertical iron ribs with fire visible only in the gaps between the ribs, and its top edge is flat. Heavy wide upper mass over a narrow waist, narrow legs and small feet, so the whole shape is top-heavy. Both hands hang empty at the sides. Short belted cloth tunic, no armour plate.
must_include: wide flat brim hat with a straight brim
broad horizontal brazier cage riding across the shoulders, wider than the body
thick vertical iron ribs across the fire, fire only visible between them
wide top over a narrow waist and narrow legs
both hands empty at the sides
must_avoid: fire escaping past the cage ribs or rising in a plume
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
held lantern, torch, pole or banner
